constitutiveModels: J2 Plasticity with Isotropic Hardening (Small & Large Strain)
materialStateManagement: IntegrationPointState tracking for plastic strain and yield stress
Trial state rollback for non-converged iterations

capabilityGaps.description: Progressive damage evolution (material softening) is not integrated into the production solver path.
Fatigue damage is currently calculated as a post-process rather than a coupled internal state variable.
Remaining Useful Life (RUL) estimation is not bound to the canonical engineering state or load history.
Fracture mechanics parameters (stress intensity factors, crack growth laws) are not explicitly supported in the core assembly.

selectedImplementationScope.damageModel: Isotropic Scalar Damage D [0, 1] with Stiffness Softening E_eff = E(1-D)
selectedImplementationScope.fatigueModel: Stress-Life (S-N) with Palmgren-Miner Linear Cumulative Damage
selectedImplementationScope.rulEstimation: Remaining cycles/blocks until D=1.0 based on current load amplitude
selectedImplementationScope.integration: Production call path integration in TET4 formulator and Nonlinear solver
